reviews.x: Fantastic lip pencils. Plenty of flattering colors to choose from for any complexion and the color lasts all day long! I am definitely recommending these to all my friends.

These pencils go on as a Matt finish and they are long lasting the pencils are  cheap looking as the cover lids slip off the pencil but over all it works and stay on and it’s worth the money - pretty good buy

reviews.t: Great liners for a great price
reviews.x: These lip liners on on very easy and stay put all day . I really like the colors as you can do multiple looks with them I highly recommended them

reviews.t: You get what you pay for
reviews.x: I'm a lip liner obsessed girl. I own over 100 from many brands.  You get what you pay for with this set.  - The colors are BEAUTIFUL. - The formula is very WAXY. - Some colors are streaky.  When my packaged arrived;  all the caps were off the pencils however my pencil were not damaged.  The cap DOES NOT hold well so I wouldn't throw this into my purse.  Will I repurchase?  NO.

You get what you pay for. I was not happy with this lip liner at all. It is really hard to get the lip liner to lay on...and once you get it on it bleeds so it doesn't stay on long.  I wouldn't purchase this again. Not worth it even with the price.

i ended up scrubbing this off my lips with an hour of putting it on. Worst lip liner I’ve ever tried. With in 30 mins it started to feather into my aging creases. Within an hour my lipstick had completely separated from it and was crackled looking. Worst lip product I’ve ever tried. Threw them all away that day. Waste of money. Colors aren’t true to the shades on the pencils. 🤬

These pencils came with 3 pencils that had already been used apparently. And all the caps fit very loosely and do not stand the pencils at all. One pencil came and didn't even have a cap on it. This was a pad purchase experience I would not recommend.  Big, big disappointment!
Very cute colors. Blends good with lipsticks.

reviews.t: Good value but colors are off
reviews.x: I like the way these have staying power. They’re a great value for the price. My only complaint is the colors are not the color the guide on the pencil indicates. They are quite off. If you’re color sensitive and aren’t flexible, don’t buy. I am fine with the colors.

reviews.t: I did not like these at all
reviews.x: Firstly...the caps just fall off. They just fall off. They don’t stay on the pencils. Secondly, they are dry as heck. They do not apply easily at all. Maybe with more frequent use they will cream up some but i did not like them at all.

None of the colors really suited me unfortunatly.. Lip liner breaks off too easy and the lids don't fit the tubes which gets annoying. Great price for the quantity though and I'm sure the colors will be good for a diff skin tone!
I dont know if I'm just used to a better quality but no matter how hard I pressed, these pencils barely leave any color and are hard to work with. Low quality throw away liners...u get what u pay for
I loved these colors and they made my lips look full. The colors are fashionable and the quality is high.
With the first one we head delivery problem that never happend before
Beautiful colors and long lasting. Value for the money.
Worked okay but a little to waxy didn’t go on smooth
Great color and staying power!  Wonderful value!

Obviously the price is relatively cheap for 12 lip liners but you get what you pay for. I’m so disappointed in this purchase. First off, the colors are rather similar to each other.. no real difference when applied. They are super hard on your lips.. not soft so application is somewhat difficult and almost hurts to use. I guess you can use the old match trick to soften them.. I didn’t get the difference between the black labeled and white labeled colors. No plumping effect whatsoever. I didn’t t

reviews.t: Cheap price for a set of lipliners
reviews.x: I like to use lipliner to line the lips before putting lipstick or sometimes I just color in the lips as it stays on longer than just using lipstick. It also doesn't have the stickiness that is associated with lipstick.  This is a good price as you get 12 for under 10 dollars which is less than a dollar each.  I like the different colors it comes with.  What I didn't like is that the caps pop off easily.  I was just putting them in and out the box and the caps keep on falling off multiple times.

reviews.t: Buy name brand to save you from the hassle
reviews.x: Big waste of money! Totally false advertisement, not water proof colors bleed I got a completely different brand and different colors than advertised then I thought I had solved the problem with customer service rep, but just received the same horrible product instead of the correct replacement. I was so excited for the replacement lip liners but now I’m just disappointed with the whole experience... I wouldn’t recommend them to anyone. You get what you pay for I guess :/

I love the range of colors and there is a rosy nude that was perfect for me! They were pretty easy to glide on and they lasted for a good amount of time. The only reason I gave 4 stars is because the beautiful purple one was a little bit streaky. The other 11 were perfect. Also there were 2 lids that were a little too big and would randomly fall off, so it's better to keep them upright in a brush holder (or coffee cup lol)

reviews.t: The caps do not stay on
reviews.x: The first thing I noticed upon opening the box was the lip liners coming out with no caps. I thought that was the way it was meant to be until I saw all the caps in the bottom of the box. The black ones stay on but the clear ones fall right off. The colors are nice however it is not practical to put them in a makeup bag, as the caps do not stay on. Its just going to end up wasting the product.

reviews.t: I doubt I’ll purchase them again
reviews.x: They’re very soft and therefore the points don’t hold up well . Having such soft liner makes them difficult to sharpen . None of the caps stay on any of the pencils and when I say won’t stay on , they’re so loose on the pencils they simply slide right off . This leaves the pencils not only exposed to the elements but to being bumped and flattened . It’s too annoying trying to keep them on .

I liked the feel of these pencils. I usually find lip pencils very drying. But these last most of the day as I use it as the base to other colors or on it's own with gloss on top. VERY NICE price too! I would recommend these to anyone wanting a variety of lip pencils. I thought the colors were varied enough for me- some browns, neutrals, pink and red.TOTALLY WORTH IT!

reviews.t: They work but are a bit annoying
reviews.x: These came in a cute box BUT when you open it all the covers fall off the pencils.  They are super lose and do not stay on. Its annoying as hell.  They pencils go on pretty easily but aren't as smooth as I hoped. Im also a red head and felt the colors don't look right on me at all.  I was disappointed and gave them to my daughter.  She hasn't used them yet.

claims.text: Many reviewers praise the long-lasting, all-day wear and staying power of these lip liners.
Reviewers frequently complain that the caps fit loosely and fall off the pencils.
The colors are widely described as beautiful and varied, though some note the actual shades don't match the pencil guide.
Several reviewers find the formula waxy, dry, or hard to apply, with some reporting bleeding or feathering.
Many reviewers consider these a good value for the price, though some feel it's a case of getting what you pay for.
